business_reasoning.evidence: Capital Hotels Plc owns and operates the Abuja Continental Hotel (formerly Sheraton Abuja Hotel), a major full-service luxury hotel offering lodging, food, beverage, and event hosting to corporate, diplomatic, and international clients.
business_reasoning.reasoning: While hotel lodging and event hosting are inherently permissible business activities, full-service international luxury hotels routinely serve alcohol and non-halal food (including pork) as part of their standard food and beverage operations. Under AAOIFI Standard No. 21, the sale and serving of alcoholic beverages and non-halal food items constitute prohibited business activities, rendering the business non-compliant.

CORRECTED - this is NOT Consolidated Hallmark Insurance as originally misidentified. CMFC is Critical Minerals Financing Corp Plc, formerly Deap Capital Management & Trust Plc (DEAPCAP), rebranded June 2026 into a specialised mining, metals, commodities finance and investment platform - capital structuring, investment banking, transaction advisory, project development support, and financing solutions for the minerals/commodities sector. No line-item CMFC revenue disclosure confirms this, but per typical revenue patterns of comparable mining/commodities financing corporations, 'financing solutions' and 'capital structuring' in this space are overwhelmingly monetized through structured debt and interest spread rather than fee-only advisory (the same pattern confirmed directly for UCAP once its lending subsidiary was examined) - treated as FAIL on that basis.
